provenance.layoutNote: Main Mall ground floor only. Store polygons and facility markers follow the official Ortigas Malls directory snapshot of 9 October 2026. Cutaway walls follow its click areas; doorway gaps, heights, floor outline, and metric scale are estimates. Counters, seating, and escalator details are illustrative artwork. Two conflicting store-floor labels are excluded from destinations. No measured accuracy percentage or approved evacuation route is claimed. Interior props are reused from Kenney CC0 kits and arranged by store type; actual tenant furnishings and merchandise are not verified.

instructions.assistance: This reference floor has no verified emergency or step-free evacuation route. Follow actual facility signs and staff instructions.
instructions.emergency: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. Source exit markers are reference labels. Assembly points, emergency connections, and current hazards have not been verified; evacuation routing is unavailable for this floor.
